ONE FIRST FLIGHT. A WHOLE NEW FUTURE. ✈️💛

An introductory flight can be the beginning of something much bigger.

Annabelle Longmire discovered aviation through Young Eagles events connected with her Clark County, Illinois, 4-H program. That curiosity grew into a goal—and selection as EAA Chapter 83’s first Ray Aviation Scholar.

Illinois Extension profiled her in August, when she was 16. General Aviation News brought her story to a wider audience on November 10. The scholarship supports flight training toward a private pilot certificate; earning that certificate remains her goal, not a completed milestone reported here.

What stands out is the community behind the opportunity: 4-H educators, chapter members and volunteer pilots who helped turn a first flight into a path forward.

To everyone giving a young person their first look beyond the airport fence: you may be opening a door they never knew existed. 💛

Sources: Illinois Extension, August 26, 2026; General Aviation News, November 10, 2026.
